title: Neeraj Kumar Rai & Ors. v. State of U.P. & Ors.
summary: UP mein B.Ed. aur TET pass umeedwaron ke post-graduation mein 50% se zyada the, par graduation mein kam. NCTE ki 29.07.2011 ki notification ke aadhaar par unhe ayogya maana gaya. Allahabad HC (25.02.2015) ne notification ko sahi thehraya tha. Supreme Court (Adarsh Kumar Goel aur U.U. Lalit, JJ.) mein appeal hui.
held: Rajasthan HC (Sushil Sompura, 20.05.2011) aur Uttarakhand HC (Baldev Singh, 20.08.2011) aise hi umeedwaron ko raahat de chuke the. NCTE ki taraf se ASG ne maana ki appellants ko barabar maana jaaye. Court ne raahat di aur NCTE ko ek mahine mein supplementary notification nikaalne ko kaha. Isi se 13.11.2019 ki notification aayi. Doosre "similarly placed persons" bhi authorities ke saamne daawa rakh sakte hain (para 9).
use: Para 7: Uttarakhand HC ka apna faisla (Baldev Singh) quote hai. Graduation mein minimum % ki shart "unreasonable, unjust and violative of Article 14".
Para 9: "any other similarly placed persons" ko bhi daawa rakhne ki chhoot. Sateshwari isi shreni mein aati hain.
13.11.2019 ki notification kahan se aayi, yeh isi faisle se saabit hota hai.
caution: Raahat mukhya roop se ASG ke "fair stand" (raza-mandi) par di gayi, poori kanooni behas par nahi (para 8–9).
Para 9: "We have not examined any such claim". Har daawa authorities apne niyam se tay karengi.
Wahan appellants ke post-graduation mein 50% the. Sateshwari ka post-graduation hai ya nahi, pata karna hoga.
bench: Adarsh Kumar Goel aur Uday Umesh Lalit, JJ. (faisla: Adarsh Kumar Goel, J.)
